page.overview:
Who is Jing?

Jing grew up darting in and out of the halls of Ba Sing Se University among people who were much older, but only half as brilliant as her. When she was not studying, Jing's brilliant mind designed all manner of wondrous draughts, tinctures, and potions.

Jing sold her inventions for fun, but when her mixtures ended up in the hands of some (well-paying) criminals, the city guards came along after Jing promised to keep her inventions out of the criminal underworld. Jing ended up meeting a group of new friends: Tao, Masaru, Sarnai, and Quartz, and loved them all. She considered all of them to be a little bit broken, but she was determined to fix anything.

Jing had a heart of gold and was a very curious person, although she could also be stubborn.

Jing was a genius potion maker and considered to be more brilliant than many who were twice of age. She made use of her potions during fights by keeping them on a bandolier.
